review.problem: The prior recording callback can still be pending after ACK and all Insert/Submission/Delivery receipts have been drained. Empty spool alone must not permit the next part.

fix.registration: Register the explicit cycleId under the spool synchronization boundary before Recorder.begin, including synchronous Off/early failure callbacks.
fix.completion: Remove the pending cycle only after the actual Recording outcome has been durably appended under the same spool lock. Failed append retains both pending registration and the latched failure.
fix.readiness: Next arming and history cleanup require no pending recording, no failure, a running writer and an empty spool.
fix.timeout: Async failure publication remains independent of the disk I/O lock.
fix.restart: The in-memory recording barrier is not a new Acquire journal. Existing durable events replay before interrupted SQLite Pending recording recovery and PLC ACK recovery.

cases: Actual Recorder writes three raw views and finishes; real SQLite already has ACK and spool is empty, but a gated actual callback keeps readiness and cleanup blocked until Recording is durably accepted and replayed.
Terminal Recording append rejected by real spool capacity retains pending cycle and failure even with empty spool.
Actual Recorder Off synchronous callback before Insert clears pending only after durable append; the queued event still blocks readiness until inserted and replayed.

limits: Original native crash recovery remains attributed to 8ffc091.
A slow recording outcome can temporarily hold readiness after ACK; original verdict and ACK are preserved, and normal readiness returns after durable acceptance and replay.
No claim of physical hardware acceptance, accuracy, power-loss zero loss or newly durable Acquire results.
